candidates.statement: Redis reserve_inventory operations time out (~2s), causing inventory /v1/reservations to return 503, order to fail with ReadTimeout, and gateway /v1/checkout to return 502. Traces show redis.reserve_inventory DependencyUnavailable: redis operation failed across all correlated requests.
candidates.uncertainty: No redis-side metrics/logs; gateway dependency_operations series empty. Root cause of redis timeout (saturation vs network) not established.

report.explanation: Checkout 502s (~2s) correlate with redis.reserve_inventory timeouts in traces, propagating 503 from inventory and ReadTimeout at order. Topology confirms inventory->redis dependency. Gateway readyz/healthz healthy, so gateway itself is not the fault. Redis-side telemetry absent, so the underlying redis fault is bounded but not fully characterized.
